userProviders.title: User Providers
userProviders.description: Connected by users for their own use only. You can view and delete them, but can't see their API Keys.

empty.title: No AI Providers Connected
empty.description: Connect one to use AI chat, question extraction from documents, image recognition, and knowledge point matching.

changeEmbedding.title: Change Embedding Model
changeEmbedding.description:
Indexes generated by different embedding models are incompatible. After changing, you must rebuild the knowledge point index, or similar question search and knowledge point matching will stop working.
Rebuilding processes all knowledge points with the new model and may take some time.

my.defaultDescription: Follows the administrator's global settings by default. You can also pick another global model or one you connected yourself. This only affects you.
my.textDescription: Your default model for AI chat, and for document imports and knowledge point matching you start.
my.visionDescription: The model used when you upload images to recognize questions.
my.embeddingNote: The embedding model for similar question search is set by administrators.
my.providersDescription: Use your own API Key. Charges go to your own account.
my.emptyDescription: You can use the administrator-configured models without adding one. To use your own account (e.g. DeepSeek credits you purchased or a stronger model), connect it here.
